# Nexloop — Complete Engineering & Delivery Dossier

> Nexloop builds custom Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) platforms, native Android and iOS mobile apps, B2B customer portals, corporate websites, and cloud API infrastructure. Tagline: innovate · connect · move.

## Entity Summary
- **Organization Name**: Nexloop Software
- **Domain**: https://nexloop.io
- **Primary Services**: Enterprise ERP Systems, Native Android & iOS Mobile Apps, Websites & B2B Customer Portals, Custom Software & Cloud Infrastructure
- **Track Record**: 48+ production systems shipped across 14 industries with 99.94% average SLA uptime and 3.2x faster post-handoff release velocity
- **Contact**: hello@nexloop.io | +1 (415) 890-4210 | North America · Europe · East Africa · Remote Worldwide

## Service Specifications

### 01. Enterprise ERP Systems
- **Summary**: Tailored ERP unifying finance, multi-warehouse inventory, procurement approvals, and branch operations into one auditable source of truth.
- **Deliverables**: General ledger, multi-currency reconciliation & tax automation; multi-warehouse stock, BOM sync & barcode dispatch; role-based PO approvals & audit trails.
- **Core Stack**: TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Redis, React.
- **Typical Impact**: Cuts manual financial and stock reconciliation by up to 60% within 90 days.

### 02. Mobile Apps (Android & iOS)
- **Summary**: Native Kotlin (Android) and Swift (iOS) applications alongside shared React Native architectures designed for offline field sync, biometric security, and 60fps responsiveness.
- **Deliverables**: Offline-first field & driver apps; App Store & Google Play release pipelines; biometric authentication, push notifications & mobile payment integrations.
- **Core Stack**: Kotlin, Swift, React Native, SQLite Sync.
- **Typical Impact**: Sub-1-second cold start and zero-drop offline synchronization.

### 03. Websites & Customer Portals
- **Summary**: Conversion-engineered corporate websites, B2B ordering portals, and SaaS platforms built for Core Web Vitals, accessibility compliance, and search/AI discoverability.
- **Deliverables**: Corporate brand sites & structured CMS workflows; B2B quote, order, and account portals; WCAG AA accessibility & technical SEO/GEO architecture.
- **Core Stack**: React, Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Edge CDN.
- **Typical Impact**: Sub-1.2-second page loads across mobile and desktop.

### 04. Custom Software, APIs & Cloud Infrastructure
- **Summary**: Bespoke operational software, legacy ERP/SAP migrations, payment and carrier API bridges, UI/UX design systems, and 24/7 DevOps monitoring.
- **Deliverables**: Custom workflow engines & zero-downtime migrations; REST/GraphQL payment, CRM & logistics API bridges; Kubernetes/AWS CI/CD & 24/7 managed SLA.
- **Core Stack**: Node.js, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS.

## Case Studies & Quantitative Proof

### 01. Meridian Logistics (Enterprise ERP — 16 Weeks)
- **Outcome**: -42% order fulfillment latency; inventory reconciliation window compressed from 4 days to real time across 14 distribution hubs.
- **Challenge**: Five disconnected regional spreadsheets and legacy billing tools delayed invoicing and caused stockouts on fast-moving SKUs.
- **Solution**: Engineered a cloud ERP with barcode dispatch scanning, automated purchase-order triggers, and live general ledger synchronization.
- **Stack**: TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Node.js, React, Redis.

### 02. Kestrel Mobility (Android & iOS — 12 Weeks)
- **Outcome**: 180,000+ active monthly users, 4.9 average app-store rating, and -66% dropped-dispatch support tickets.
- **Challenge**: Field drivers in low-connectivity industrial corridors lost active job state mid-route.
- **Solution**: Built an optimistic offline-first sync queue with conflict-free reconnection, Apple Pay / Google Pay checkout, and native push dispatch alerts.
- **Stack**: Swift, Kotlin, React Native, WebSockets, PostgreSQL.

### 03. Atlas Fabrication (Web & Custom Software — 10 Weeks)
- **Outcome**: +165% qualified B2B inquiries and 18 hours/week of manual quote entry eliminated.
- **Challenge**: Sales engineers re-keyed web quote requests into costing sheets manually.
- **Solution**: Rebuilt the corporate web platform paired with an interactive CAD quote estimator wired directly into CRM and shop-floor scheduling APIs.
- **Stack**: React, Tailwind CSS, REST APIs, Cloudflare, AWS.

## Engineering Delivery Process
1. **Discovery & Architecture (Weeks 1–2)**: Shadow existing workflows, audit legacy APIs and spreadsheets, and produce a fixed architectural blueprint.
2. **Product Design & Prototype (Weeks 3–4)**: Interactive Figma flows validated with operators and end users before production coding.
3. **Agile Engineering & QA (Weekly Sprints)**: Automated test suites, staging demos, security audits, and inspectable TypeScript, mobile, and ERP codebases.
4. **Rollout & Managed SLA (Launch & Beyond)**: Zero-downtime data migration, team training, app-store publishing, and 24/7 monitoring.

## Frequently Asked Questions (Direct Answers)

### How long does it take Nexloop to build and launch a custom ERP or software system?
Most production MVP launches take 10 to 16 weeks depending on scope. Web platforms and B2B quote portals typically ship in 10 weeks, dual-platform Android and iOS suites in 12 weeks, and multi-warehouse ERP consolidations in 16 weeks with weekly staging demos throughout delivery.

### Do we own the full source code and intellectual property after launch?
Yes. Clients receive 100% ownership of all custom source code, architectural documentation, database schemas, and cloud infrastructure-as-code repositories upon milestone completion, with zero vendor lock-in or proprietary runtime licensing fees.

### Should we choose native Kotlin/Swift or React Native for our mobile application?
Nexloop recommends native Kotlin and Swift when apps demand hardware-intensive Bluetooth/telemetry, background GPS tracking, or complex offline storage, and React Native when shared velocity across Android and iOS business workflows is the priority—both backed by automated store release pipelines.

### Can Nexloop integrate new custom software with our existing ERP, banking, or payment APIs?
Yes. Every engagement can bridge legacy accounting cores, regional banking rails, mobile money gateways, warehouse scanners, and CRM systems via idempotent REST, GraphQL, or webhook pipelines without disrupting daily operations.

### What happens after launch—does Nexloop provide ongoing maintenance and SLAs?
Yes. Teams can either take full internal handoff with training and automated CI/CD suites, or retain Nexloop for a 24/7 managed SLA covering security patches, cloud scaling, uptime monitoring (99.94% average), and continuous feature sprints.
